DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りですか。ロープの手前でお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is something wrong? Please tell me from this side of the rope.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子が風で飛んで、ロープの向こうに落ちました。近くに見えるのですが、拾いに行く前に入ってよい場所か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風で飛んだ帽子がロープ先にあり拾う前に立入り可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind blew my hat away, and it fell beyond the rope. I can see it nearby, but before going to pick it up, I want to ask whether entry is allowed there.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your hat blew beyond the rope, and ask whether entry is allowed before retrieving it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先は現在立入りを規制する表示があります。物が見えていても、ロープを越えて取りに行かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is currently a sign restricting entry beyond this point. Even if you can see your belongings, do not cross the rope to retrieve them.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐ近くだから大丈夫と思わず、ここから出ません。帽子の場所を指して、担当の方に知らせることはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近いから可とせず手前に留まり帽子位置を担当へ知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume it is all right just because it is close, and I will stay here. May I point out the hat's location and tell the person responsible?
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay on this side without assuming entry is allowed because it is close, and want to tell the responsible person where the hat is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手前から場所を伝えることはできます。回収できるか、いつできるかは私から確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may explain its location from this side. I cannot promise whether it can be recovered or when.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回収を約束してもらうつもりはありません。自分で長い物を差し出したりせず、落ちた位置だけを担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 回収確約を求めず長い物を差し出さず位置だけ報告したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am not asking for a guarantee of recovery. I only want to tell the person responsible where it fell, without reaching out with a long object myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are not asking for guaranteed recovery and only want to report the location, without reaching out with a long object. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 位置の確認として引き継ぎます。連絡を待つ場合も、規制区域の入口ではなく案内所側でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass this on as a request to check the location. If you wait for a response, please wait near the information center rather than at the entrance to the restricted area.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内所側へ戻ります。待つ間に休める場所も知りたいですが、海へ近づける場所ならどこでもよいとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所側へ戻り海近くならどこでもよいとせず休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will return to the information-center side. I would also like to know somewhere to rest while waiting, but I do not assume that any place close to the sea is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will return toward the information center, and ask where to rest without assuming that anywhere near the sea is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内所の休憩場所をご案内します。天候で利用案内が変わる場合があるので、表示と職員の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the rest area at the information center. Access guidance may change with the weather, so please check signs and staff instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は海際へ進まず、案内所の休憩場所で担当の連絡を待ちます。帽子が見えなくなっても、自分だけで追いかけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 海際へ進まず休憩場所で連絡を待ち帽子が見えなくても単独で追わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will not go toward the water's edge. I will wait for the staff member's response in the information center's rest area. Even if I lose sight of the hat, I will not go after it on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay away from the water's edge and wait for a response in the rest area, and will not chase the hat alone even if it disappears from view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では落ちた場所の説明を担当へつなぎます。規制はそのまま守り、こちらでお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person responsible so you can explain where it fell. Keep following the restrictions and wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通勤用の傘をお探しですか。今の傘で困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an umbrella for commuting? Is anything about your current umbrella troublesome?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長い傘を忘れやすいので、かばんに入る折り畳み傘を探しています。二つのうち軽い方に決めそうになりましたが、収納の仕方も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 長傘を忘れるため折畳みを探し軽さだけでなく収納も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I tend to forget long umbrellas, so I am looking for a folding one that fits in my bag. I almost chose the lighter of these two, but I also want to see how it is stored.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forget long umbrellas and want a folding one, and want to check storage as well as light weight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本で畳んだ大きさを比べられます。実際のかばんに入るかも確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can compare their folded sizes using these samples. Would you also like to check whether they fit in your actual bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。長さだけでなく太さも気になります。無理に押し込まず、かばんの内寸と比べて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 畳んだ長さと太さをかばん内寸と比較し無理に押し込まず選びたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I am concerned about thickness as well as length. Rather than forcing one in, I would like to compare it with the bag's internal dimensions before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare the folded length and thickness with the bag's internal dimensions and choose without forcing it inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 収納時の寸法をこちらでご覧ください。袋については、こちらの商品は本体と一緒に付属品欄に記載があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the dimensions when stored here. For this product, the sleeve is listed in the accessories section along with the umbrella itself.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋があるだけで、濡れたまま長くしまってよいという意味ではありませんね。使った後の乾かし方も説明で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋付属を濡れたまま長期収納可とせず乾燥手入れを説明で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Having a sleeve does not mean it can be stored wet for a long time, does it? I would also like to check the instructions for drying it after use.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that an included sleeve does not mean long-term storage while wet is acceptable, and you want to check drying and care instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手入れの説明はこちらです。袋の用途も含めてお読みください。見本に水をかける試験はご案内していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: The care instructions are here. Please read them, including the intended use of the sleeve. We do not offer a test that involves pouring water on the sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水をかけて試したりはしません。説明を読んで、外で使った後の手入れを続けられるかも考えます。重さは袋を含む表示ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本へ水をかけず手入れを検討し重さ表示が袋込みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not test it by pouring water on it. I will read the instructions and consider whether I can keep up with the care after using it outdoors. Does the listed weight include the sleeve?
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not pour water on the sample, will consider its care, and ask whether the listed weight includes the sleeve. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その表示範囲は商品担当へ確認します。軽さだけでなく付属品を含めた持ち運びの条件で比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the product staff what that weight covers. Let's compare the carrying conditions including accessories, as well as how light the umbrella is.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず袋を含む重さを確認し、かばんに入る寸法と手入れ方法を合わせて選びます。最初に見た軽い方を、まだ会計へ回さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋込み重さ・寸法・手入れを確認するまで軽い方の候補の会計を進めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will check the weight including the sleeve, then choose by considering the dimensions that fit my bag and the care instructions together. Please do not send the lighter one I first looked at to checkout yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them not to proceed to checkout with the lighter candidate until you check the weight including the sleeve, dimensions, and care. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品は未購入のまま、表示の範囲を確認します。見本はこちらでお戻ししますので、ごゆっくりお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will leave the product unpurchased while checking what the listed information covers. I will put the samples back, so please take your time choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの写真をお持ちですね。現在はまだ入場されていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a photo of your meeting place. Have you not entered yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。友人が送った大きな模型の前で会うつもりでしたが、入口からはその模型が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未入場で友人写真の模型前に会う予定だが入口から見えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I planned to meet in front of the large model in the photo my friend sent, but I cannot see it from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not entered and plan to meet by the model in your friend's photo, but cannot see it from the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真の模型は入場後の展示室にあります。写真だけを見て、そのまま展示室へ通れるとは考えず、まず入場の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: The model in that photo is in an exhibition room after admission. Rather than assuming the photo means you can go straight into the room, please check the admission information first.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人と話してから見学するか決めたいので、模型を見るためだけに入場はしません。入場前に会える目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見学判断前に話したいので模型のためだけに入場せず入場前目印を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to talk to my friend before deciding whether to visit, so I will not enter just to see the model. Please tell me a landmark where we can meet before admission.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to talk before deciding to visit, will not enter just for the model, and ask for a landmark before admission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付前の案内板なら入場前の場所です。ただし待つ間も通路は空けてください。お友達に変更を連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The information board in front of reception is before the admission area. Please keep the walkway clear while waiting. Can you tell your friend about the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「模型の前ではなく、受付前の案内板の横で会いたい」と送ります。友人は展示室内なので、外へ出られるかは本人に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付前案内板横への集合変更を送り友人には退出可能か本人確認を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will send, "I would like to meet beside the information board in front of reception, rather than in front of the model." My friend is in the exhibition room, so I will ask them to check for themselves whether they can come out.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will send a change of meeting place to beside the information board in front of reception and ask your friend to check personally whether they can leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 再入場などの条件が関係する場合も、ご本人が受付へ確認する必要があります。こちらで自由に出入りできると約束はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: If re-entry conditions or similar rules are involved, your friend needs to check with reception personally. We cannot promise here that they may come and go freely.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に、簡単に出て戻れるはずだとは言いません。受付で条件を確かめてから、集合変更でよいか返事をもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自由な出入を約束せず友人が条件を確認後に集合変更同意を返してもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not tell my friend that it should be easy to come out and return. After they check the conditions at reception, I will ask them to reply whether the meeting change works.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not promise unrestricted exit and entry, and will have your friend agree to the change after checking the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お返事を待つなら案内板の横へどうぞ。会えない場合は、展示を終えた後に会う案も考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please go beside the information board if you are waiting for a reply. If you cannot meet now, meeting after your friend finishes viewing the exhibits is another option.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通路を空けて待ちます。今すぐ会う変更が難しければ、友人の見学が終わってからにし、勝手に模型の所へ入らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け待ち変更困難なら見学終了後に会い無断で模型へ入らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait with the walkway clear. If changing to meet right now is difficult, we will meet after my friend finishes, and I will not go to the model without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without blocking the walkway, meet after the visit if changing is difficult, and not go inside to the model without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内板の横でご連絡をお待ちください。入場について決められたら受付へお声かけください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait beside the information board for contact. Once you decide about admission, please speak to reception. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車についてのご相談ですね。人数と、お持ちの荷物を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about traveling. May I ask the number of passengers and what luggage you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 大人二人で利用を考えています。楽器の入った大きいケースがあり、席を二つ買えばケースも座席へ置けるのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大人二人で楽器ケースがあり二座席購入でケースを置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are considering traveling as two adults. We have a large case containing a musical instrument, and would like to know whether buying two seats allows us to put the case on a seat too.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two adults have an instrument case, and ask whether buying two seats allows the case to be placed on a seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人数分の座席と、大きい荷物の持込み条件は別に確認します。ケースの大きさがわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check seats for the passengers separately from the conditions for bringing large luggage. Do you have something showing the case's dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦・横・厚みを測ったメモがあります。楽器入りだと伝えて、座席か別の場所か、どう扱うかを担当に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 縦横厚みメモを示し楽器入りとして収納場所や扱いを担当へ確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a note of its height, width, and thickness. Please tell the staff member that it contains an instrument and ask how it would be handled, including whether it goes on a seat or somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your note of the height, width, and thickness, state that it contains an instrument, and ask them to check its storage location and handling with the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 寸法と内容を担当へ伝えます。追加の費用や、扱える便があるかも確認してからご案内します。まだ購入前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff member the dimensions and contents. We will also check additional fees and whether any services can accommodate it before advising you. You have not bought yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ買っていません。追加費用があるなら二人分の運賃と合わせた総額を聞き、条件がわかってから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未購入で二人運賃と追加費用込み総額を条件後に比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. If there is an additional charge, I want to hear the total including fares for two people and choose after understanding the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not bought yet and want to compare the total including fares for two and extra charges after understanding the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 総額と条件を確認します。天候などで運行の案内が変わる場合は、当日の情報も見る必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the total and conditions. If service information changes because of weather or other factors, you also need to check information for the actual day.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前もって利用できると聞いても、当日必ず動くという保証とは思いません。運休になった場合の連絡と、購入したものの扱いも先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事前案内を当日運行保証とせず運休連絡と購入分の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if told in advance that we can use it, I will not take that as a guarantee it will operate that day. I would also like to know beforehand how cancellation is announced and what happens to what we purchased.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not treat advance information as a guarantee of operation that day; ask about cancellation notices and what happens to purchased tickets or services. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 運行確認の方法と運休時の取扱いをご案内します。ケースを持って乗り場へ行く経路も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain how to check operations and what happens in a cancellation. Do you also need a route to the boarding point while carrying the case?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要です。ケースを置いたまま先に乗り場へ行かず、二人で持ち物を確認して移動します。荷物条件と総額を聞くまでは購入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ケースを置き去りにせず二人で移動し荷物条件と総額確認まで購入しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will not leave the case behind and go ahead to the boarding point; the two of us will check our belongings and move together. Please do not make a purchase until we hear the luggage conditions and total cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave the case unattended and will move together after checking your belongings, and ask them not to make a purchase until the luggage conditions and total are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では楽器ケースの条件から照会します。購入と持込みはまだ確定していません。こちらでお待ちください。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will inquire about the instrument case conditions first. Neither the purchase nor permission to bring it aboard is confirmed yet. Please wait here. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計前の明細をご覧ください。気になる項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please look at the itemized bill before payment. Are there any entries you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: セットを二つ頼み、そのうち一つの飲み物をコーヒーにしました。明細にはセットのほかにコーヒーがあり、追加で頼んだ扱いか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: セット二つの一つをコーヒーにし単品欄のコーヒーが追加扱いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: We ordered two set meals, and I chose coffee as the drink for one. There is a coffee listed in addition to the sets, and I want to know whether it is being treated as an extra order.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose coffee for one of two sets, and ask whether the coffee in the individual-item section is treated as an extra. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: セットに含む選択と単品の追加を、注文記録で確認します。コーヒーを別に追加された覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the order record to distinguish choices included in the sets from additional individual items. Do you remember ordering a separate coffee?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 追加はしていません。最初に紅茶と言ってから、出してもらう前にコーヒーへ変更したので、その変更が別注文になったのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加でなく提供前の紅茶からコーヒーへの変更だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not order an extra. I first said tea, then changed to coffee before it was served, so perhaps that change became a separate order.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it was a change from tea to coffee before serving, not an additional order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の記録を確認します。お連れの方の飲み物も、別々に伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the change record. May I also ask separately what your companion drank?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連れはセットの紅茶を一杯です。二人で紅茶とコーヒーを一杯ずつ飲み、飲み物を追加でもう一杯は受け取っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 連れは紅茶一杯で二人が各一杯のみ受取り追加一杯はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: My companion had one tea included in the set. Between us, we had one tea and one coffee, and did not receive another extra drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your companion had one tea, that each of you received only one drink, and that no extra drink was received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録では、セットの変更分と単品分が重複しています。単品の一件を外して明細を出し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: The record duplicates the set's changed drink and an individual item. I will remove the one individual item and reissue the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 修正後に、セット二つと飲み物の扱いをもう一度見ます。修正前の合計のまま支払わないよう、確定を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修正後のセットと飲料扱いを再確認し旧合計で支払わないよう確定を待ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: After the correction, I will check the two sets and how the drinks are handled again. Please wait before finalizing it so that I do not pay the old total.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will recheck the sets and drinks after correction, and ask them to wait before finalizing so you do not pay the old total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが単品分を外した明細です。確認後のお支払い方法を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the bill with the individual item removed. After you check, I will ask how you would like to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: セット二つで余分な単品がないことを確認しました。この明細でまとめて現金で払います。修正後の内容がわかるレシートもください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 余分な単品なしを確認し修正明細で一括現金払いと修正後レシートを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed there are two sets and no extra individual item. I will pay the whole corrected bill in cash. Please also give me a receipt showing the corrected contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm there is no extra individual item, ask to pay the corrected bill together in cash, and request a corrected receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では修正後の合計で現金のお会計を承ります。お会計後に、修正後のレシートをお渡しします。確認のお時間をいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your cash payment for the corrected total. After payment, we will give you the corrected receipt. Thank you for allowing us time to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の説明で聞き取れなかったところはありますか。始める前に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there anything you could not hear in the morning briefing? We will check before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中で音が大きくなり、場所の名前と「入る」「入らない」のところが聞こえませんでした。推測して動く前に、もう一度お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 騒音で場所名と入る入らないが聞こえず推測移動前に再説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: It became noisy partway through, and I could not hear the location name or the part about entering or not entering. Please explain again before I move based on a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that noise prevented you from hearing the location and whether to enter, and request another explanation before moving based on a guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞こえなかったまま移動しないでください。担当の責任者が、図と合わせて説明し直します。どの部分まで確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not move without having heard it clearly. The person in charge will explain again using a diagram. How much have you confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 資材の確認を担当するというところまでは聞けました。ただ、作業する範囲と待機する場所を同じだと思ってよいかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 資材確認担当は聞けたが作業区域と待機場所を同じとみなせるか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard up to the part that I am responsible for checking materials. But I do not know whether I can consider the work area and waiting place to be the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you heard you are assigned to check materials, but do not know whether the work area and waiting place can be considered the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作業範囲と待機場所は分けて示します。今はこの指定の待機場所にいて、責任者の説明を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will show the work area and waiting place separately. For now, stay in this designated waiting place and receive the supervisor's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。図の色だけを見て判断せず、私の担当場所と立入れない場所を、文字と指示でも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定場所で待ち色だけでなく文字と指示で担当と立禁区域を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait here. Rather than judging only by the diagram's colors, I would like to check my assigned place and prohibited areas through the text and instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait in the designated place and want to check assigned and prohibited areas using text and instructions, as well as colors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 責任者と一緒に確認しましょう。使う道具や装備も説明しますが、場所がわかれば機械を操作してよいという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with the supervisor. We will also explain tools and equipment, but knowing the location does not mean you may operate machinery.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 未説明の機械は触りません。資材の確認でも使ってよい道具と必要な保護具を確認し、操作の権限があるかも分けて聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未説明機械に触れず道具・保護具・操作権限を分けて聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not touch machines that have not been explained. Even for checking materials, I will check which tools I may use and the required protective equipment, and ask separately whether I am authorized to operate anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not touch unexplained machinery, and will ask separately about tools, protective equipment, and operating authorization. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。説明を聞き直した後には、理解した内容を言い返して照合しましょう。違いが残る間は作業を始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After hearing the explanation again, repeat back what you understood so we can compare. Do not start work while discrepancies remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当は資材の確認ですが、区域・経路・道具の詳細はこれから責任者と照合します。聞こえたつもりで作業へ行かず、ここで説明を受けてから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資材確認担当だが区域経路道具は未照合と復唱し再説明前に作業へ行かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am assigned to check materials, but the details of areas, routes, and tools still need to be checked with the supervisor. I will not go to work assuming I heard correctly; I will receive the explanation here before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you are assigned to check materials but have not yet verified areas, routes, and tools, and will not go to work before the explanation is repeated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは待機場所で責任者の再説明につなぎます。不明な点を伝えていただきありがとうございます。確認までそのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will arrange the supervisor's explanation again in the waiting place. Thank you for telling us what was unclear. Please stay where you are until it is confirmed. Please excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更の入力をまだ送信する前ですね。どの箇所を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have not submitted the address-change entry yet. Which part would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい住所を入れましたが、部屋番号の数字の順が、持参した書類と違います。送信してから直すのではなく、ここで止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所の部屋番号の順が書類と違い送信前に止めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I entered my new address, but the digits of the room number are in a different order from the document I brought. Rather than correcting it after submitting, I want to stop here.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the order of the room-number digits differs from the document, and you want to stop before submitting the new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送信せずに、書類と入力を一項目ずつ見直しましょう。番地と部屋番号をまとめて読まず、分けて示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's review the document and entries one item at a time without submitting. Could you show the street number and room number separately rather than reading them together?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地はこの部分、部屋番号はその下です。建物名の後の数字を写すときに、順番を逆にしました。元の書類は変えず入力の方を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋を分け建物後の数字転記逆転を入力側で直し原書類は変更しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: The street number is this part, and the room number is below it. When copying the digits after the building name, I reversed their order. I will correct the entry, without changing the original document.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Separate the street and room numbers, explain that you reversed the copied digits after the building name, and will correct the entry without changing the source document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力欄を見直してから担当に確認します。通知の送付先について、居住する住所と別の場所を希望しているわけではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will review the fields and then check with the staff member. For the destination of notices, you are not requesting somewhere different from your residential address, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は自分が住む新住所への変更です。友人に一時預かってもらう場所を、登録住所として書くつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 居住新住所の変更で友人の一時預り先を登録するつもりでないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: This time I am changing it to my new address where I live. I do not intend to register the place where a friend temporarily holds things for me as my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that this is a change to your new residential address, not an attempt to register a friend's temporary holding address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 居住住所の変更として確認します。必要な本人確認と、通知へ反映される条件は担当がご案内します。電話番号も変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check this as a change of residential address. The staff member will explain the necessary identity verification and the conditions for updating notices. Has your phone number changed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話は変わっていません。住所を直すついでに、電話まで変更したことにせず、その欄は変更なしとして見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話は不変なので住所変更と同時に電話も変えた扱いにしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: My phone number has not changed. While correcting the address, I do not want the phone number treated as changed too; I would like to review that field as unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your phone number is unchanged and should not be treated as changed together with the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象を住所の変更に絞って確認しましょう。送付先と反映についての案内を聞いてから、申請へ進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's focus the check on the address change. After you hear the guidance about the delivery destination and when changes take effect, we can proceed with the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号、建物名、電話変更なしを読み返します。通知がいつからどこへ準備されるかを聞き、本人確認の案内も受けてから送信したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号・建物・電話変更なしを読み直し通知反映と本人確認の案内後に送信したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will reread the room number, building name, and unchanged phone number. I want to ask from when and to where notices will be prepared, and receive identity-verification instructions before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will reread the room number, building name, and unchanged phone number, and want guidance on notice updates and identity verification before submitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では入力は未送信のまま、担当の確認へ進みます。住所の反映はまだ完了していません。お声かけありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-045-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will proceed to the staff member's check while leaving the entry unsubmitted. The address update is not complete yet. Thank you for speaking to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の確認ですね。どの駅で降りたいか、わかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check your route. Do you have something showing the station where you want to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人からこの駅へ来てと言われました。ここに出ている列車はもっと先まで行くので、途中のその駅でも降りられると思ったのですが、乗換えの表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人指定駅より先へ行く列車なのに乗換表示があると尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend asked me to come to this station. The train shown here goes farther, so I thought I could get off at that station along the way, but it shows a transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why a transfer is shown even though the train goes beyond the station your friend specified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 終点が先でも、目的の駅に停まるかは別です。この候補では目的駅を通過するため、途中で別の列車へ乗り換える表示になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even if the terminus is farther away, whether the train stops at your station is a separate matter. This option passes through your destination without stopping, so it shows a transfer to another train partway.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先まで行くことと、途中の駅すべてに停まることを同じに考えていました。乗り換える駅と、最後に降りる駅を分けて示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 終点と全駅停車を混同したと述べ乗換駅と最終降車駅を分けて示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was treating going farther as the same as stopping at every station along the way. Please show me the transfer station and final destination separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you confused a farther terminus with stopping at every station, and ask to see the transfer station and final destination separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが乗換駅、こちらが目的駅です。候補のうち、出発が早いものと乗換えが少ないものでは、どちらを優先しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the transfer station, and this is your destination. Among the options, do you prefer an earlier departure or fewer transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗換えの少ない方を優先します。少し出発が後でも、知らない駅で急いで移動する回数を減らしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発が少し後でも知らない駅での急な移動を減らすため乗換少なめを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I prefer fewer transfers. Even with a slightly later departure, I want to reduce the number of times I have to hurry through unfamiliar stations.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer fewer transfers, even with a slightly later departure, to reduce hurried moves through unfamiliar stations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件の候補を確認します。乗換えの場所で、ホームの表示に迷ったらどうするかも考えておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check options that meet that condition. Let's also consider what you should do if the platform signs at the transfer point confuse you.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 終点の名前だけで次の列車に乗らず、目的駅に停まるかの表示も見ます。わからなければ乗る前に係員へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終点名だけで選ばず目的駅停車表示を見て不明なら乗車前に係員へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not board the next train based only on its terminus name; I will also check whether it stops at my destination. If I am unsure, I will ask staff before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not choose only by the terminus name, will check destination stop information, and ask staff before boarding if unsure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。案内の列車名と時刻も、その時の発車表示に照らし合わせてください。乗車前に、経路を言い返してみますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also compare the train name and time in the directions with the departure display at that time. Would you like to repeat the route before boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内の乗換駅で降り、目的駅に停まる列車へ移るのですね。乗換駅を友人の最寄り駅と取り違えず、表示を照合してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗換駅と友人の最寄り駅を区別して停車列車へ乗り発車表示も照合すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I get off at the transfer station in these directions and change to a train that stops at my destination, correct? I will not confuse the transfer station with the station nearest my friend, and will check the displays before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will distinguish the transfer station from the station nearest your friend, board a train that stops at your destination, and check the departure display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その二つの駅を分けてお確かめください。こちらが確認した経路です。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check those two stations separately. Here is the route we confirmed. Take care, and have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望場所へのご案内ですね。屋外の道についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like directions to a viewing area. Are you asking about the outdoor path?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外の展望台へ行きたいです。入口の掲示には通れないとありますが、階段の方からなら行けるのか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 屋外展望路が通れない掲示を見て階段経由なら行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the outdoor observation deck. The sign at the entrance says it is not passable, but I want to ask whether I can go by the stairs instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After seeing a sign that the outdoor viewing path is impassable, ask whether you can go via the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は屋外の展望路全体を閉じているという掲示です。別の階段を使って、閉じた先へ回ることはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sign means the entire outdoor viewing path is closed today. Do not use another staircase to go around into the closed area.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階段なら例外だと思わず、外へ出るのはやめます。長い階段も苦手なので、屋内で景色を見られる場所があれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を例外とせず屋外をやめ長い階段なしの屋内眺望を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not assume the stairs are an exception, and will not go outside. I also find long stairways difficult, so please tell me if there is somewhere indoors to see the view.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not assume stairs are an exception; say that you will not go outside, and ask for an indoor view without a long stairway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この階の窓側に見学の場所があります。ただし、天候によって見える範囲は変わり、遠くまで見えることは約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a viewing area by the windows on this floor. However, the visible area changes with the weather, and we cannot promise distant views.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: よく見えるまで外で待とうとはせず、今日は窓から見える範囲で楽しみます。窓辺で写真を撮る場合、通路はどこを空ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遠景保証を求めず窓からの範囲を楽しみ撮影時に空ける通路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than waiting outside until visibility improves, I will enjoy what I can see from the window today. If I take pictures by the window, which part of the walkway should I leave clear?
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enjoy the view available through the window without seeking guaranteed distant views, and check which walkway to leave clear while photographing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この床の線の外側は通行のため空けてください。窓へ寄る際も、ほかの方や足元をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave the area outside this line on the floor clear for passage. When approaching the window, also check for other people and watch your footing.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 線をまたいで通路へ荷物を置かず、荷物は自分で持ちます。撮るときに後ろへ下がる前も、人がいないか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通行側に荷物を置かず持ち撮影で後退前に周囲を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not put belongings across the line into the walkway, and will keep them with me. Before stepping backward to take a picture, I will also check that no one is there.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will carry your belongings rather than leave them in the passage, and check around you before stepping back to take a picture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。見学後は、こちらの受付側へ戻る経路です。出口の表示を確認してお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After viewing, the return route goes toward reception here. Please check the exit signs when leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 窓側の見学を終えたら受付へ戻ります。外の展望路を帰りの近道にも使わず、屋内の出口表示に沿って出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 屋内見学後は受付へ戻り閉鎖屋外路を近道に使わず出口表示に従うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: After I finish viewing by the window, I will return to reception. I will not use the outdoor viewing path even as a shortcut back, and will follow the indoor exit signs to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return to reception after indoor viewing, not use the closed outdoor route as a shortcut, and follow the exit signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は屋内の見学で承りました。屋外の閉鎖はそのままお守りください。どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You will view from indoors today. Please continue to observe the outdoor closure. Take your time and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 庭園を訪れるご予定についてですね。見学と体験のどちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are planning a visit to the garden. Would you like sightseeing or an activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と明日来たいです。庭を見るついでに、この体験もそのまま参加できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌日友人と庭見学のついでに体験へそのまま参加できると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to come with my friend tomorrow. I thought we could simply join this activity while visiting the garden.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought you could simply join the activity while visiting the garden with your friend tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内では通常の見学と、予約が必要な体験を分けています。体験の内容と申込み条件を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This guide separates ordinary visits from activities requiring reservations. Let's check the activity details and application conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 葉の観察をする体験に興味があります。庭へ入る予定を立てただけでは、体験の席も取れているわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 葉観察体験を希望するが見学予定だけでは体験席未確保と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am interested in the leaf-observation activity. Just planning to enter the garden does not mean places in the activity have been secured too, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want the leaf-observation activity, and check that planning a garden visit alone does not secure activity places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご希望の日に受け付けているか、担当へ照会します。人数と、参加に使える時間を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. I will ask the staff member whether it is available on your preferred day. Please tell me the number of people and the time you can spend participating.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大人二人で、午前中だけ使えます。午後の体験しかない場合は、無理に参加しようとせず、見学だけにするか友人と相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大人二人午前のみで午後しかなければ友人と見学のみを相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two adults, and we are only available in the morning. If there is only an afternoon activity, I will not try to force it into our schedule; I want to discuss with my friend whether to just visit the garden.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that there are two adults available only in the morning, and that if only afternoon sessions exist, you will discuss just sightseeing with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 午前の可否と所要の案内を確認します。申込みは、確認画面まで進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check morning availability and the guidance on duration. Have you reached the confirmation screen for the application?

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ入力もしていません。問い合わせをしただけで予約済みとは言わず、申込み方法と完了の確認方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未入力で問い合わせを予約済みとせず申込方法と完了確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not even entered anything yet. I will not say we are booked just because I made an inquiry. I would like to know how to apply and how to confirm completion.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have entered nothing and do not consider an inquiry a reservation, and ask how to apply and confirm completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の申込み案内をお示しします。天候で予定が変わる場合の確認先も、合わせて確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the staff member's application instructions. Let's also check where to get information if the schedule changes because of weather.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時、二人の枠、完了確認、変更時の連絡先を控えます。友人には体験はまだ未予約と伝え、回答を見てから明日の予定を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時二人枠完了確認変更連絡先を控え体験未予約と友人へ伝え回答後予定決定と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note down the date and time, places for two, confirmation of completion, and the contact for changes. I will tell my friend the activity is not booked yet, and decide tomorrow's plan after seeing the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the date and time, places for two, completion check, and contact for changes; tell your friend it is unbooked, and decide after the reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-046-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
